errors: Blog post description was 168 chars; check_post_frontmatter.py caught it in the local run and it was shortened.

doc_friction.issue: Step 0 says fix the open list first, but all 10 open entries are control-plane workflow edits that already have owner-gated PRs (#14612, #12926/#14877, #14808, #14698, #14894, #15201, #15248, #15561, #12928). A run on one branch can do nothing with them, and `redteam.py open` does not show the existing PR, so each run spends time searching for it. Suggest a `pr` field on open entries and a filter that hides entries waiting on the owner.
The suggested aim at files that changed on main in the last 3 days (shift-roster-builder, changepoint-detector) found only suites over 20 s, so the run fell back to the random draw.

deviations.why: Step 4b asks for a guard that runs without an agent. The defect class (keyword regexes with no word boundaries in transaction categorisers) is in only one file in ventures/ (grep for unit\s?\w+ and |lease|), and a generic lint would fire on many legitimate substring patterns.
deviations.did: Covered it with a test of lookalike words in the venture's own suite, which ventures-tests.yml runs on every PR. No new lint.
deviations.result: The guard covers this venture only.

notes: Three campaigns (visit-keeper/usage.mjs, rental-property-schedule-e-categorizer/calc.mjs, crypto-cost-basis-calculator/calc.mjs), 8 mutants each: 18 of 24 caught (78% of the 23 non-equivalent). Of the 6 escapes, 1 is equivalent and 5 are gaps (rerun: all caught_after_fix true). One real defect was found by reading the code and patched. Checked locally: node --test in all three ventures (44, 129, 43 pass) and run_workflow_locally.py --for-changes.
corrections: First count in the PR body and post said 19 of 24 caught; the tally says 18 of 24 (7+5+6). Corrected before merge.

real_defects.issue: Rent keyword regex had no word boundaries (unit\s?\w+, lease, rental), so credits like UNITED AIRLINES REFUND, COMMUNITY BANK INTEREST, ESCROW SURPLUS RELEASE and RENTAL CAR REFUND were booked as Schedule E rent, inflating rental income. Fixed with \bunit\b, \blease, \brental(?!\s+car); test added.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
